d:
Relive the classic era with the soul-stirring 'Bada Dukh Dina Mere Lakhan Ne' from the iconic film Ram Lakhan. Immerse yourself in the nostalgia of the 80s as the enchanting vocals of Lata Mangeshkar grace this timeless track.
Song Credits:
Song: Bada Dukh Dina
Movie: Ram Lakhan
Singer: Lata Mangeshkar
Director: Subhash Ghai
Producer: Ashok Ghai
Music Director: Laxmikant-Pyarelal
